articles.title: Bitcoin falls below $60,000 as AI trade continues to draw investor interest and capital
articles.snippet: South Korean memory chip giant on Wednesday filed to raise nearly $30 billion in a U.S. offering.

articles.title: Crypto-backed candidates notch wins in three US state primaries
articles.snippet: The crypto-aligned Fairshake PAC and its affiliates spent a combined $8 million on media to support candidates in Maryland, New York and Utah amid pushback from many criticizing “crypto billionaires.”

articles.title: Binance withdraws Greece-filed MiCA application
articles.snippet: Binance said it plans to seek authorization in another EU jurisdiction just days ahead of the July 1 MiCA deadline, as unlicensed crypto firms are expected to wind down activities in the bloc.

articles.title: The Studio Behind 'Ex Machina' Is Now Researching AI With Google
articles.snippet: Google is investing $75 million in A24 as part of a new AI research initiative focused on filmmaking tools.
